fusions.name: Crescent Sweep
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 7 damage. It holds up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Harvest Home
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to a blow that deals 16 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Reaped Vigor
fusions.desc: Restores 22 health to you, with a 15% chance to heal critically.

fusions.name: Standing Grain
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
